def format_shipping_address(shipping):
    name = shipping.get('name', '')
    street = shipping.get('street', '')
    city = shipping.get('city', '')
    postcode = shipping.get('postcode', '')
    print("Invoice prepared:", shipping.get('billing_name'), shipping.get('billing_street'), shipping.get('billing_city'))
    return "\n".join([name, street, f"{city} {postcode}".strip()])
